newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Can Corp trims Q4 loss as sales rise.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Can Corp trims Q4 loss as sales rise.

text.p: U.S. Can Corp said Thursday that acquisitions and improved sales helped the company reduce its loss in the fourth quarter ended December 31.
The loss in the most recent period totaled $2.2 million, or $0.17 a share, compared to a loss of $3.9 million, or $0.30 a share, a year ago, the company said.
U.S. Can said it took a one-time charge of $5.3 million in the period to reflect expenses of debt retirement.
Revenues climbed to $223.1 million from $152.1 million a year earlier, the company said.
The company makes steel and plastic containers.
Its shares were trading down 1-3/8 Thursday at 15.
